rule: Buildings whose registry lot has no building in MapPLUTO 26v2 (or is missing from it), moved to the lot the pipeline's building identity step (buildings.lots) gives, where PAD's address ranges put the building's StreetEasy street address on that lot exactly (rank 0) and the lot holds apartments in MapPLUTO 26v2

overrides.label: 199 BRIDGE STREET
overrides.evidence: PAD 26c puts 165 Concord Street in an address range of lot 3001080003 in the record's zip; StreetEasy's building record gives class C1, built unknown, unknown floors, unknown apartments; MapPLUTO 26v2 lot 3001080003 is 199 BRIDGE STREET, class C1, built 1915, 4 floors, 16 apartments; the pipeline's building identity step links it (both)
overrides.registry_was: address, BBL 3001080001: MapPLUTO 26v2 has  BRIDGE STREET, class QG, built 0, 0 apartments, and no building area
